stem.text: A man stands in a lift that is accelerating vertically downwards, as shown.

stem.alt: Diagram of a lift containing a standing man, with a downward arrow labelled acceleration beside the lift.

stem.text: Which statement describes the force exerted by the man on the floor?

A.text: It is equal to the weight of the man.

B.text: It is greater than the force exerted by the floor on the man.

C.text: It is less than the force exerted by the floor on the man.

D.text: It is less than the weight of the man.
